list.label_ko: 중반: 영웅 Lv10, 무기 +0, 힘 14, 12층 브루트
list.choice: JUDGMENT: STR 14 = 10 + 2*(12//5), only the two completed floor sets' guaranteed potions by depth 12 (conservative). Tier 4-5 weapons are therefore under-strength (accuracy/speed penalty) - intended.

list.label_ko: 중반 대조군: 영웅 Lv10, 무기 +0, 힘 = 무기 요구힘, 12층 브루트
list.choice: Every weapon at exactly its STR requirement (no penalty, no bonus): isolates raw weapon stats.

list.label_ko: 후반: 영웅 Lv22, 무기 +6, 힘 18, 20층 골렘
list.choice: JUDGMENT: STR 18 = 10 + 2*(20//5), four completed floor sets by depth 20 (assumes every guaranteed potion was found). The brief suggested ~16; change heroStr here and rerun.

limitations: Enchantments, glyphs, talents, rings, Duelist abilities, surprise attacks and Duelist charges are ignored.
Blocking weapons (shields, Quarterstaff, Katana, Rapier) are scored on offence only.
Single-target steady state; no enemy attacks, regeneration, or hero armor.
Mob defence/DR are base values; no Barkskin, champions, or ascension scaling.
Float32 rounding inside Random.NormalIntRange is ignored (pmf is exact for ideal floats).

desc.text: 이 가벼운 갑옷은 기본적인 보호를 제공합니다.

dr.formula: DRMax = tier*(2+lvl); DRMin = lvl (while lvl < DRMax); hero drRoll = NormalIntRange(DRMin, DRMax)

desc.text: 거대한 철판들이 이어져 갑옷으로 만들어졌습니다. 이 갑옷의 엄청난 무게를 견딜 수 있는 모험가들에게 다른 갑옷과는 비교할 수도 없는 방어력을 제공해 줍니다.

lowStr.effect: armor DR roll reduced by 2*(STRReq - STR)

rules.excessStr: No armor bonus from excess STR; it only avoids the penalties above.

augment.effect: EVASION augment: evasion +round((2+lvl)*2), DR max +round((2+lvl)*-1); DEFENSE augment: evasion round((2+lvl)*-2), DR max +round((2+lvl)*1)

classArmor.text: Class armor defaults to tier 5 but copies the tier of the armor it was crafted from; same DR/STR formulas. Ability costs are not covered here.

changelog.quote: **-** Crystal enchantment having lower durability than intended at melee weapon levels above +6
**Crystal** weapons are weak overall currently, so I'm giving them some major buffs, especially at lower levels:
**-** Crystal damage bonus up to +33% from +25%
**-** The crystal bow specifically always has 50 avg uses
Crystal thrown weapons specifically are also getting a nerf:
**-** Max uses until breaking for crystal thrown weapons down to 30, from 50.
**- Crystal** is a new rare enchant that boosts damage, but requires you to work around limited durability.
